ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows multiple windings on the same closed iron core; the left side is connected to a three-phase balanced power supply, labeled 230∠0° V, 230∠−120° V, 230∠120° V; windings A, B, C are wound on this iron core, and there is winding X on the right side. The winding arrows/winding directions in the figure only indicate the relative directions of the windings. According to the winding directions in the figure, under the specified orientation, A and B can be regarded as aiding the magnetic flux linked with X, and C as opposing the magnetic flux linked with X. Reasoning: Let the three-phase RMS voltage phasors be Va = 230∠0°, Vb = 230∠−120°, Vc = 230∠120°. Since A, B, C each have 20 turns, and according to the relative winding directions in the figure A and B aid and C opposes, the equivalent 20-turn voltage corresponding to the magnetic flux linked with X is Va + Vb − Vc. Calculate the balanced three-phase phasors: Va + Vb − Vc = 230∠0° + 230∠−120° − 230∠120°, whose magnitude is 460 V RMS. X has only 2 turns, while A, B, C have 20 turns, so the induced voltage is scaled according to the turns ratio: Vx = (2/20) × 460 = 46 V RMS. Rounded to 2 decimal places, it is 46.00 V.

method.method_draft: Assign RMS phasors Va=230∠0°, Vb=230∠−120°, Vc=230∠120°. From the image senses, take A and B as aiding the X-linked flux and C as opposing it, so the equivalent 20-turn voltage corresponding to the flux linked by X is Va+Vb−Vc, up to an irrelevant overall sign. Evaluate |Va+Vb−Vc|; for balanced phases this magnitude is 460 V. Since X has 2 turns while A/B/C have 20 turns, compute Vx=(2/20)·460=46 V RMS.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是同一闭合铁芯上的多个绕组，左侧接有三相平衡电源，标注为 230∠0° V、230∠−120° V、230∠120° V；绕组 A、B、C 绕在该铁芯上，右侧有绕组 X。图中绕组箭头/绕向只表示绕组相对方向。根据图中绕向，按指定取向可把 A、B 看作对 X 所链磁通为助磁，C 对 X 所链磁通为反磁。

推理：令三相 RMS 电压相量为 Va = 230∠0°，Vb = 230∠−120°，Vc = 230∠120°。由于 A、B、C 各为 20 匝，且按图中相对绕向 A、B 助磁、C 反磁，所以与 X 所链磁通对应的等效 20 匝电压为 Va + Vb − Vc。计算平衡三相相量：Va + Vb − Vc = 230∠0° + 230∠−120° − 230∠120°，其幅值为 460 V RMS。X 只有 2 匝，而 A、B、C 为 20 匝，因此感应电压按匝数比例缩放：Vx = (2/20) × 460 = 46 V RMS。四舍五入到 2 位小数为 46.00 V。

method.method_draft: Mark dots on A, B, C, and X from the shown winding directions. Form the equivalent voltage that would appear on a 20-turn winding having X's polarity by adding the source phasors with these dot signs: E20=Va+Vb−Vc. method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图是一个矩形铁芯上的绕组示意图，左侧有三相电源，分别标注为 230∠0° V、230∠−120° V、230∠120° V，接到同一铁芯上的 A、B、C 三个绕组；右侧同一铁芯上还有绕组 X。图中绕组只画出了绕向/极性关系，不代表实际匝数。按图中绕向标点后，相对于绕组 X 的选定极性，A 和 B 的贡献为正，C 的贡献为负。推理：A、B、C 各为 20 匝，先求一个与 X 极性相同的等效 20 匝绕组上的电压。按指定符号相加，E20 = Va + Vb − Vc。三相平衡时 Va + Vb + Vc = 0，因此 Va + Vb = −Vc，所以 E20 = −Vc − Vc = −2Vc。每相电压 RMS 幅值为 230 V，因此 |E20| = 2×230 = 460 V。实际 X 绕组只有 2 匝，按匝比换算：|Vx| = (2/20)×460 = 46 V RMS。四舍五入到两位小数为 46.00 V。
